products.name: Integrated Subsea Systems and Services
products.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures, installs, and services fully integrated subsea production systems, field infrastructure, and pipeline systems for offshore oil and gas production, using proprietary technologies, specialized vessels, and digital platforms. Includes Subsea Production Systems (SPS), Subsea Processing Systems, Subsea Umbilicals, Risers and Flowlines (SURF), and life-of-field services.

products.name: Subsea Robotics and ROVs
products.description: Designs and manufactures remotely operated vehicles (ROVs), robotic tooling systems, and manipulator arms for subsea operations, enabling safe and efficient deepwater development. Delivered as physical equipment and technology solutions for subsea intervention and construction.

products.name: Subsea Digital Solutions
products.description: Provides digital platforms and software (e.g., Subsea Studio™) to optimize the development, execution, and operation of subsea fields, connecting data and technology for improved decision-making and operational efficiency. Delivered as digital-only solutions integrated with physical systems.

products.name: Surface Drilling and Completion Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and services drilling and completion systems, including wellheads and production trees, for onshore and shallow water oil and gas exploration and production. Delivered as engineered equipment and field services for well construction and operation.

products.name: Surface Wellhead and Production Tree Systems
products.description: Provides surface wellhead and production tree systems for controlling and regulating oil and gas flow from wells, including high-pressure and high-temperature applications, with associated services and digital monitoring. Delivered as manufactured equipment and field support.

products.name: Stimulation and Pressure Pumping Systems
products.description: Offers integrated pressure control systems (e.g., iComplete®) and related equipment for hydraulic fracturing and stimulation in onshore unconventional oil and gas operations, including digital automation and field services. Delivered as rental equipment, digital solutions, and on-site support.

products.name: Flexible Pipe and Flowline Products
products.description: Manufactures and supplies flexible pipe and flowline products (e.g., Coflexip®, PumpFlex™, Chiksan®, Weco®) for drilling, stimulation, and production operations, including high-pressure and high-volume applications. Delivered as physical products and integrated with service offerings.

products.name: Production Separation and Processing Systems
products.description: Provides technology and equipment for the separation of oil, gas, sand, and water in production facilities, including modular and digital solutions for onshore and offshore applications. Delivered as engineered systems and modules for field deployment.

products.name: Standard Pumps
products.description: Designs and supplies reciprocating pumps and complete skid solutions for oil and gas applications, customized for pressure and flow requirements. Delivered as manufactured equipment with design and commissioning services.

products.name: Well Control and Integrity Systems
products.description: Supplies hydraulic and electrical control components and safety systems for well pads, offshore platforms, and production facilities, designed for safe and efficient operations with minimal maintenance. Delivered as standardized equipment and integrated solutions.

products.name: Integrated Carbon Transportation and Storage Solutions
products.description: Develops and supplies integrated systems and equipment for carbon transportation and storage (CTS), including CO2 injection wellheads, subsea and surface injection equipment, and digital monitoring solutions for GHG removal projects. Delivered as engineered systems leveraging existing oil and gas technologies.

products.name: Offshore Floating Renewables Systems
products.description: Provides integrated systems and technologies for offshore floating renewables, including dynamic inter array cables (DIAC), mooring and anchoring systems, and water column integration for floating wind projects. Delivered as engineered solutions and project integration services.

products.name: Hydrogen Production, Storage, and Power Solutions
products.description: Develops and integrates systems for offshore hydrogen production, compression, storage, and re-electrification (e.g., Deep Purple™), providing stable renewable energy supply via microgrid solutions. Delivered as integrated technology platforms and pilot projects.

products.name: Identity Security Cloud
products.description: A cloud-based SaaS platform that centrally discovers, manages, and secures all enterprise identity types (human, non-human, machine, AI agents) and associated data and cloud infrastructure, leveraging AI and automation for identity governance, compliance, and security.

products.name: IdentityIQ
products.description: A customer-hosted (on-premises or private cloud) identity security solution for large, complex organizations requiring data localization, providing unified and configurable identity governance, compliance, and access management across applications and data.

products.name: Agent Identity Security
products.description: A solution for comprehensive governance, compliance, and security of AI agents, enabling aggregation, discovery, assignment, certification, and governance of AI agent identities within a unified platform.

products.name: Machine Identity Security
products.description: A solution for governance, compliance, and security of machine accounts (service accounts, bots, etc.), enabling discovery, classification, assignment, certification, and lifecycle management of machine identities with minimal manual processes.

products.name: Observability & Insights
products.description: A SaaS solution providing advanced visualization, enriched metadata, and analysis to deliver continuous, interactive views of identities, entitlements, and access relationships, improving governance and reducing risk.

products.name: Accelerated Application Management
products.description: An intelligent, scalable application governance solution that provides immediate visibility into application landscapes and reduces reliance on application owners and IT teams, streamlining application onboarding and management.

products.name: Non-Employee Risk Management
products.description: A solution to streamline administration and risk-based access for non-employee identities (contractors, partners, vendors), supporting regulatory compliance and secure third-party lifecycle management with flexible workflows.

products.name: Data Access Security
products.description: A SaaS solution integrated with Identity Security Cloud to discover, govern, and secure unstructured data in cloud storage, providing automated data discovery, classification, and governance workflows to improve data security and compliance.

products.name: Password Management
products.description: A self-service password management solution for business users to manage and reset passwords across all systems, enforcing consistent password policies and synchronizing changes to enhance security and reduce IT workload.

products.name: Access Risk Management
products.description: A solution that unifies identity security controls and Separation of Duties monitoring across ERP and business applications, automating access reviews, risk mitigation, and compliance processes to reduce fraud and audit deficiencies.

products.name: Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM)
products.description: A solution to discover, manage, govern, and remediate access to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), providing AI-driven entitlement permissioning and visibility into cloud privileges for compliance and security.

products.name: Privileged Task Automation
products.description: A solution to automate and delegate repeatable privileged tasks without sharing credentials, using centralized repositories, low-code automation, and workflow templates to improve productivity and reduce privileged access risks.

products.name: File Access Manager
products.description: A product for securing access to data stored in file servers, collaboration portals, mailboxes, and cloud storage, providing data discovery, classification, policy controls, and compliance automation to mitigate data risks.

products.name: Commercial Automobile Insurance
products.description: Policies providing protection against liability for bodily injury and property damage from automobile accidents, as well as coverage for damage to automobiles owned by businesses. These are underwritten and delivered through independent agents, requiring regulated insurance infrastructure and claims management.

products.name: Commercial Multi-Peril Insurance
products.description: Policies that combine liability and physical damage coverages to protect businesses against a variety of perils. Delivered via independent agents, these products require underwriting, regulatory compliance, and claims servicing.

products.name: Workers’ Compensation Insurance
products.description: Insurance policies purchased by employers to provide benefits to employees for work-related injuries, as determined by state law. Requires regulated underwriting, claims management, and compliance with state-specific workers’ compensation statutes.

products.name: Other Commercial Insurance
products.description: A range of additional commercial insurance products, including commercial umbrella liability and other specialized coverages, delivered through independent agents and requiring regulated underwriting and claims services.

products.name: Private Passenger Automobile Insurance
products.description: Policies providing liability and property damage protection for individuals’ personal vehicles, including coverage for bodily injury, property damage, and loss from damage to owned automobiles. Sold via independent agents, requiring regulated underwriting and claims processing.

products.name: Homeowners Insurance
products.description: Policies covering damage to residences and contents from perils such as fire, theft, and weather, as well as liability for injuries occurring on the property. Delivered through independent agents, requiring regulated underwriting and claims management.

products.name: Other Personal Insurance
products.description: A variety of additional personal insurance products, such as dwelling fire and other specialized coverages, delivered through independent agents and requiring regulated underwriting and claims services.

products.name: Entertainment and Amusement Attractions
products.description: A wide array of in-venue entertainment options including arcade games, redemption games, simulation games, virtual reality, bowling, laser tag, billiards, and gravity ropes, delivered through physical venues with proprietary and third-party games, some exclusive to the brands.

products.name: Food Service
products.description: Full-service dining with a menu focused on modern American cuisine, including entrées, appetizers, burgers, steaks, pasta, and dietary options, prepared and served in-venue with an emphasis on quality, speed, and evolving customer tastes.

products.name: Beverage Service
products.description: Full bar service offering a variety of beers, hand-crafted cocktails, and premium spirits, available throughout the venues and designed for high margin and streamlined execution.

products.name: Sports Viewing Experiences
products.description: Immersive in-venue sports viewing with large high-definition screens, enhanced audio-visual technology, and dedicated areas for watching live sports and other programming, integrated with food and beverage service.

products.name: Special Event Hosting
products.description: Hosting and organizing group events, parties, and ticketed experiences with tailored entertainment and banquet menu offerings, supported by dedicated sales teams and online booking capabilities.

products.name: Franchise Operations
products.description: International franchising of the Dave & Buster’s brand, providing franchisees with brand, menu, entertainment, and operational support to open and operate venues in foreign markets.

products.name: Flat-Rolled Steel Products
products.description: Manufactured at electric arc furnace steel mills using recycled scrap, these include hot rolled, cold rolled, and coated sheet steel products. They are produced, processed, and distributed through various divisions and coating lines, and delivered to end users, processors, fabricators, and service centers.

products.name: Long Steel Products
products.description: Produced at four mills and downstream finishing operations, these include structural beams, channels, angles, reinforcing bar, rails, engineered bar products, merchant bar, and specialty shapes. Products are manufactured using EAF technology and may undergo additional finishing such as threading, heat treating, and fabrication.

products.name: Metals Recycling Services
products.description: Processing, transportation, marketing, and sale of ferrous and nonferrous scrap metals, including sorting, shredding, shearing, cutting, baling, and breaking. Scrap is sourced from industrial, dealer, and retail channels and sold to steel mills, foundries, smelters, and other consumers.

products.name: Steel Fabrication Products
products.description: Manufacture of non-residential building components, including steel joists, joist girders, and steel deck systems, at dedicated fabrication plants. Products are fabricated from steel and delivered to construction and building industry customers nationwide.

products.name: Aluminum Flat-Rolled Products
products.description: Production of flat rolled aluminum coil products with high recycled content at a dedicated mill and slab centers. Products serve the beverage can, automotive, and industrial sectors, with value-added finishing and packaging lines.

products.name: Electricity Generation, Transmission, and Distribution
products.description: Evergy generates electricity using a diverse portfolio of fuel sources (coal, wind, natural gas, uranium, solar), transmits it over regulated infrastructure, and distributes it to residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, and wholesale customers in Kansas and Missouri. This involves physical generation assets, regulated transmission lines, and distribution networks.

products.name: Wholesale Power Sales
products.description: Evergy sells excess electricity not required by its retail customers into the wholesale market, primarily through participation in the SPP Integrated Marketplace. This involves competitive bidding and regulated transactions with other utilities and market participants.

products.name: Electric Transmission Services
products.description: Evergy provides regulated electric transmission services, including ownership and operation of high-voltage transmission lines and participation in joint ventures for regional transmission projects. These services are delivered through physical infrastructure and are regulated by FERC and state commissions.

products.name: Customer Energy Efficiency Programs
products.description: Evergy offers energy efficiency programs to help customers reduce energy usage and manage costs. These programs are delivered through customer incentives, demand-side management, and regulatory-approved initiatives, with costs recovered through regulated mechanisms.

products.name: AlloNK (AB-101) NK Cell Therapy
products.description: An allogeneic, non-genetically modified, cryopreserved natural killer (NK) cell therapy manufactured from donor cord blood, designed to be combined with B-cell targeted monoclonal antibodies for the treatment of B-cell driven autoimmune diseases and certain cancers. The product is pre-manufactured, stored frozen, and shipped to treatment locations as an off-the-shelf infusion-ready therapy.

products.name: AB-201 HER2-targeted CAR-NK Cell Therapy
products.description: An allogeneic, cord blood-derived CAR-NK cell therapy engineered to target HER2-expressing tumor cells, designed for the treatment of HER2-positive solid tumors such as breast, gastric, esophageal, and bladder cancers. The product is manufactured using a proprietary process and is intended as an off-the-shelf cell therapy.

products.name: AB-205 CD5-targeted CAR-NK Cell Therapy
products.description: An allogeneic, cord blood-derived CAR-NK cell therapy engineered to target CD5-expressing tumor cells, intended for the treatment of T-cell lymphomas and leukemias. The product is manufactured using a proprietary process and is designed as an off-the-shelf cell therapy.

products.name: Construction Aggregates
products.description: Extraction and production of construction aggregates such as crushed stone, sand, and gravel, primarily through open pit and underground mining, delivered to customers via truck, rail, barge, or ship for use in construction and infrastructure projects.

products.name: Low Carbon Fuels and Renewable Chemical Products
products.description: Production and commercialization of renewable diesel, sustainable aviation fuel, renewable naphtha, and other chemical feedstocks derived from waste plastics and biomass using licensed and proprietary process technologies. Products are manufactured at modular facilities and are designed to be compatible with existing refining and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Crude Pyrolysis Oil Derived from Plastics
products.description: Production and sale of crude pyrolysis oil generated from waste plastics using continuous pyrolysis technologies, intended for use by refiners and chemical manufacturers. This product is sold under contractual agreements, primarily in Europe, and is produced at planned facilities using licensed technologies.

products.name: Legacy Oil and Gas Production
products.description: Exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas from legacy assets, primarily in the Permian Basin and U.S. Gulf Coast region. Operations are maintained for compliance and existing revenue, with no new capital allocated.

products.name: Circuit Protection Components
products.description: Designs and manufactures a broad range of circuit protection products including fuses, resettable fuses, battery cable protectors, high-current and high-voltage fuses, circuit breakers, and protection relays. These are physically manufactured components used to protect electrical systems in electronics, transportation, and industrial applications.

products.name: Power Semiconductor Devices and Modules
products.description: Produces and sells power semiconductor components and modules such as TVS diodes, thyristors, MOSFETs, IGBTs, rectifiers, and wide band gap devices. These are manufactured using in-house and external wafer fabrication and are used for power conversion, regulation, and protection in high-power and energy-dense applications.

products.name: Electromechanical Switches and Interconnect Solutions
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets electromechanical switches and interconnect solutions, including reed switches, relays, and connectors. These are physical components used for switching and connectivity in electronics, industrial, transportation, and aerospace applications.

products.name: Sensing Technologies and Sensors
products.description: Develops and supplies a variety of sensors and sensing technologies, such as magnetic sensing, temperature sensors, and sensors for occupant safety, position, and battery management. These are manufactured components integrated into vehicles, industrial equipment, and electronics for monitoring and control.

products.name: Power Distribution Modules and Units
products.description: Manufactures and sells power distribution modules and units, including power control and distribution products for commercial vehicles and industrial applications. These are assembled hardware systems used to manage and distribute electrical power safely and efficiently.

products.name: Electrical Shock and Arc Fault Protection Devices
products.description: Designs and produces electrical shock protection devices, ground fault circuit interrupters, residual current devices, and arc fault detection devices. These are safety-critical, regulated products used in industrial, utility, and renewable energy applications to protect personnel and equipment.

products.name: Embedded Software and Firmware Solutions
products.description: Provides embedded software and firmware solutions primarily for transportation and commercial vehicle electronification and eMobility. These are digital products developed and delivered for integration into customer hardware platforms.

products.name: ECO Synthesis Manufacturing Platform for RNAi Therapeutics
products.description: A proprietary enzymatic platform and associated services for the large-scale manufacture of RNA interference (RNAi) therapeutics, including siRNA drug substances. Delivered through in-house labs and partnerships with CDMOs, it includes process development, analytical method development, and manufacturing of both non-GMP and future GMP-grade RNAi materials.

products.name: Pharma Biocatalysis Enzymes and Services
products.description: Engineered enzymes sold as biocatalysts to pharmaceutical manufacturers for use in the production of small molecule therapeutics, including both commercial and clinical-stage drugs. Includes enzyme supply, process development, and contracted research and development partnerships for custom enzyme engineering.

products.name: Licensing of Enzyme Technology Platforms
products.description: Licensing of proprietary enzyme engineering platforms (such as CodeEvolver) to pharmaceutical companies, enabling them to develop custom-designed enzymes for their own manufacturing processes. Revenue is generated through upfront, milestone, and royalty payments.

products.name: Enzymes for Molecular Biology and Genomics Applications
products.description: Development and licensing of specialized enzymes for molecular biology applications such as mRNA manufacturing, next generation sequencing, diagnostic testing, and DNA oligonucleotide synthesis. Delivered through licensing agreements and royalty arrangements with life sciences companies.

products.name: Prepared Italian-Style Meat Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed all-natural, ready-to-heat Italian-style meat products including beef, chicken, and turkey meatballs, meat loaf, and sausage-related products, primarily sold refrigerated in retail deli sections. Production requires physical manufacturing in USDA-certified facilities and regulated food safety processes.

products.name: Prepared Pasta and Rice Entrees
products.description: Manufactures and sells all-natural, ready-to-heat pasta and rice entrees, distributed refrigerated to supermarkets and other retailers, produced in company-owned facilities under regulated food safety standards.

products.name: Prepared Deli Salads
products.description: Produces and distributes a variety of refrigerated deli salads, including protein and vegetable-based salads, sold in retail and bulk packaging to supermarkets and food distributors, manufactured in company facilities.

products.name: Olives and Olive Mixes
products.description: Manufactures and sells pre-packaged olives and olive mixes, distributed primarily to large retail customers, produced in company facilities and sold under the Olive Branch brand.

products.name: Prepared Sandwiches and Paninis
products.description: Produces and sells ready-to-eat sandwiches and paninis, including retail-pack paninis targeting snacking and on-the-go occasions, distributed refrigerated to supermarkets and convenience stores.

products.name: Premium Ready-to-Heat Meals
products.description: Manufactures and markets a range of premium, value-added, ready-to-heat meals featuring distinctive protein cuts and claims-driven protein solutions, produced in SQF and USDA-certified facilities and sold to retail and club channels.

products.name: Master Planned Communities (MPCs)
products.description: Planning, development, and management of large-scale, mixed-use communities, including the horizontal development of residential and commercial land, which is sold primarily to homebuilders and developers. Requires extensive land use planning, entitlement processes, and infrastructure development.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing (Retail, Office, Multifamily)
products.description: Ownership and operation of income-producing properties, including retail centers, office buildings, and multifamily residential properties, generating recurring revenue primarily through rental services. Involves property management, leasing, and ongoing asset repositioning or redevelopment.

products.name: Condominium Development and Sales
products.description: Development, marketing, and sale of condominium units, primarily in high-density residential towers. Requires entitlement, design, construction, and regulatory compliance, with revenue generated from unit sales rather than recurring rental income.

products.name: Commercial Land Sales and Leasing
products.description: Sale or lease of land parcels designated for commercial development, including retail, office, hospitality, and high-density residential projects. Involves preparing land with major utilities and infrastructure for external buyers or lessees.

products.name: Specialty Insurance and Reinsurance (pending acquisition)
products.description: Provision of specialty insurance and reinsurance products through Vantage Group Holdings Ltd., a business expected to be acquired. Involves underwriting and risk management services for external clients.

products.name: Hydraulic and Mechanical Tools
products.description: Design, manufacture, and distribution of branded high-force hydraulic and mechanical tools such as cylinders, pumps, valves, bolt tensioners, and specialty tools. These products are manufactured through light assembly of sourced components and are delivered globally via distributors and direct sales.

products.name: Heavy Lifting Technology Solutions
products.description: Provision of highly engineered heavy lifting technology solutions for precise positioning of heavy loads, often used in mission-critical and harsh industrial environments. These solutions are developed through advanced engineering and are delivered as specialized equipment or systems.

products.name: Industrial Maintenance and Manpower Services
products.description: Provision of maintenance and manpower services on customer assets, including bolting, machining, and joint integrity, delivered by highly trained technicians on-site at customer locations.

products.name: Tool Rental Services
products.description: Rental of hydraulic and mechanical tools and equipment to customers in various industrial sectors, allowing temporary access to specialized tools without ownership. Rental services are offered for certain products through the company's distribution network.

products.name: Biomedical Textile Product Development
products.description: Development and production of biomedical textile products through Cortland Biomedical, involving specialized textile engineering and manufacturing for medical applications. This is a smaller, distinct business line outside the core industrial tools segment.

products.name: Gold Products
products.description: Gold is extracted from owned and joint venture mines using milling or heap leaching, then refined into doré bars or concentrate, which are sold as bullion or to third-party smelters/refiners. Production requires physical mining, processing plants, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Silver Products
products.description: Silver is produced as doré bars or concentrate from mining operations, using milling or heap leaching, and sold as bullion or to third-party smelters/refiners. Production involves physical mining, processing, and compliance with environmental and mining regulations.

products.name: Copper Products
products.description: Copper is produced from the Los Azules project as concentrate or cathode, using open pit mining and processing plants, and sold to external customers. Production requires significant physical infrastructure, mining, and processing operations.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provides commercial and industrial loans to small business, middle market, corporate, and institutional borrowers for working capital, inventory, debt refinancing, business acquisitions, and other business-related financing needs. Loans are delivered through branches, loan production offices, and specialized teams, and require in-person underwriting and ongoing credit monitoring.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans for the purchase, refinance, and construction of commercial real estate properties, including multi-tenant retail, hotels, gas stations, industrial warehouses, and multi-family residences. Loans are secured by real estate and require physical collateral evaluation and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending
products.description: Provides SBA-guaranteed loans, including SBA 7(a), SBA 504, and SBA EZ loans, to small businesses for working capital, equipment, real estate, and business acquisitions. Loans are originated through specialized departments and may be sold in the secondary market, generating servicing income.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans including single-family mortgages, personal loans, and home equity loans to individuals. Mortgages are secured by residential real estate and delivered through branch and online channels, requiring regulatory compliance and underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Provides a wide range of deposit accounts and related services to consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, time deposits, IRAs, and public deposits. Delivery is through branches, ATMs, and digital platforms, with FDIC insurance and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Offers treasury management solutions such as remote deposit capture, lockboxes, ACH origination, and cash management services to business clients. Services are delivered via digital platforms and require integration with client operations and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Foreign Currency Exchange Solutions
products.description: Provides foreign currency exchange services to customers, facilitating international transactions and currency needs. Services are delivered through branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and compliance.

products.name: Interest Rate Risk Hedging Products
products.description: Offers interest rate risk management products, such as swaps or caps, to commercial clients to hedge against interest rate fluctuations. Products are delivered through specialized teams and require financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: International Trade Financing
products.description: Provides financing solutions for international trade, including letters of credit and other trade finance products, to support import and export activities. Delivered through specialized teams and requires regulatory and compliance infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Delivers internet and mobile banking services, including online account management, bill-pay, and mobile deposit, to consumers and businesses. Services are digital-only and require secure technology infrastructure.

products.name: Rinzimetostat (PRC2 Inhibitor)
products.description: A small molecule, orally bioavailable allosteric inhibitor of the PRC2 complex via the EED subunit, developed for the treatment of advanced prostate cancer and potentially other solid tumors. Manufactured through chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral drug, it is advanced through clinical trials and may be commercialized as a prescription oncology therapeutic.

products.name: Enozertinib (Brain-Penetrant EGFR Inhibitor)
products.description: A brain-penetrant, orally bioavailable, irreversible small molecule inhibitor targeting EGFR exon 20 and EGFR atypical mutations, developed for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and other solid tumors with EGFR mutations. Produced via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral drug, it is advanced through clinical trials and may be commercialized as a prescription oncology therapeutic.

products.name: CD73 Inhibitor Program (ORIC-533)
products.description: An orally bioavailable small molecule inhibitor of CD73, designed to block adenosine production in the tumor microenvironment and enhance immune response against cancer. Developed through chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral drug, it has completed Phase 1b trials in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma and is positioned for out-licensing or further development.

products.name: PLK4 Inhibitor Program (ORIC-613)
products.description: An orally bioavailable small molecule inhibitor of PLK4, intended to exploit synthetic lethality in tumors with TRIM37 amplification, particularly in breast cancer. Developed through chemical synthesis, it has completed IND-enabling studies and is positioned for out-licensing or further development.

products.name: PTV Software Platform for CTV Performance Marketing
products.description: A self-serve, cloud-based software platform that enables marketers to plan, launch, optimize, and measure targeted Connected TV (CTV) advertising campaigns, integrating AI-driven audience targeting, automated ad buying, cross-device attribution, and real-time reporting. Delivered digitally as a SaaS solution, it requires no physical manufacturing and is accessed directly by customers of all sizes.

products.name: Creative Solutions for TV Advertising
products.description: A suite of creative services and tools, including access to a marketplace of independent creators (QuickFrame), that enables customers to quickly and cost-effectively produce, upload, and adapt professional TV ads for CTV campaigns. Delivered digitally and through a network of creators, this service streamlines ad creation and ensures compliance with TV network standards.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, and government-guaranteed SBA loans. These loans are originated and serviced through physical branches and specialized lending offices, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Offers loans and credit services to individual farmers, farming businesses, and corporate agricultural entities, including agricultural real estate loans. Delivered through specialized agricultural credit centers and requires in-person expertise and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides loans to individuals, including residential equity lines of credit and personal loans. These are delivered through branch locations and digital channels, requiring financial capital and compliance with consumer lending regulations.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Offers loans for construction and land development projects, primarily to businesses and developers. These loans are originated through branches and require specialized underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provides loans secured by residential real estate, including mortgages and home equity lines. Delivered through branch offices and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a wide range of deposit products for individuals, businesses, and public entities, including checking, savings, money market, sweep, time deposit, and retirement accounts. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital and Remote Banking Services
products.description: Provides electronic banking services such as mobile banking, internet banking with bill payment, remote deposit capture, and telephone banking. These services are delivered digitally and require investment in technology and cybersecurity.

products.name: Treasury Management and Payment Services
products.description: Offers treasury management solutions, ACH origination, wire transfers (including international), business online banking, and fraud prevention tools such as Positive Pay. Delivered through digital platforms and branch support, requiring technology infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: ATM and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides access to cash and account management through a network of ATMs, night depository, and related services. Requires physical infrastructure and integration with national networks.

products.name: Other Ancillary Banking Services
products.description: Offers additional banking services such as cashier’s checks, safe deposit boxes, direct deposit, electronic funds transfers, and FedNow®-receive Service. Delivered through branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Sheet Steel Products
products.description: Manufactured using electric arc furnaces and automated rolling mills, Nucor produces hot-rolled, cold-rolled, and galvanized flat-rolled steel sheets for automotive, appliance, construction, pipe and tube, and other industrial applications. Products are delivered to customer specifications, often under contract.

products.name: Bar Steel Products
products.description: Produced at bar mills using electric arc furnaces, these include concrete reinforcing bars, merchant bars, SBQ (special bar quality), wire rod, and highway products in carbon and alloy steels, serving construction, automotive, energy, and other sectors.

products.name: Structural Steel Products
products.description: Manufactured at structural mills, these include wide-flange beams, pilings, and heavy structural steel, including high-strength, low-alloy beams (AEOS®), primarily for construction and infrastructure projects.

products.name: Steel Plate Products
products.description: Produced at plate mills, these steel plates are used by manufacturers of barges, bridges, heavy equipment, rail cars, refinery tanks, ships, wind towers, and for construction and transportation industries.

products.name: Steel Joists, Decking, and Grating
products.description: Manufactured and fabricated at Vulcraft/Verco facilities, these include open-web steel joists, joist girders, steel decking, and steel bar grating, primarily for nonresidential building construction and maintenance markets.

products.name: Tubular Steel Products
products.description: Produced at tubular facilities, these include HSS steel tubing, mechanical tubing, galvanized solar torque tube, piling, sprinkler pipe, heat-treated tubing, and electrical conduit for structural, mechanical, and energy applications.

products.name: Rebar Fabrication and Installation Services
products.description: Nucor Rebar Fabrication fabricates, installs, and distributes reinforcing steel products for concrete construction in infrastructure and building projects, providing both product and installation services on a contract basis.

products.name: Pre-Engineered Metal Buildings and Components
products.description: Through the Buildings group, Nucor supplies customized pre-engineered metal building packages and components, manufactured at multiple facilities and sold primarily through builder networks for commercial, industrial, and institutional use.

products.name: Insulated Metal Panels
products.description: Manufactured under brands like CENTRIA and Metl-Span, these panels provide climate control and energy efficiency for warehousing, distribution, and data centers, produced at specialized facilities.

products.name: Steel Racking and Data Center Infrastructure
products.description: Nucor Racking Group manufactures and installs standard and custom steel racking systems, airflow containment structures, cabinets, and enclosures for warehouses and data centers, including installation services.

products.name: Overhead and High-Performance Doors
products.description: Manufactured under brands such as C.H.I. Overhead Doors and Rytec, Nucor produces overhead doors for residential and commercial markets, including high-speed, high-performance doors, at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Utility Towers and Steel Structures
products.description: Produced by Nucor Towers & Structures, these include steel poles and structures for utility infrastructure, manufactured at specialized facilities adjacent to steel mills.

products.name: Steel Piling and Geostructural Foundation Products
products.description: Skyline Steel distributes and manufactures steel foundation products, including sheet piling, pipe piling, and geostructural solutions for construction and infrastructure projects.

products.name: Cold Finished Steel Bars
products.description: Produced at cold finish facilities, these bars are cold-drawn, turned, ground, and polished for precision applications in automotive, appliance, and machinery industries.

products.name: Steel Mesh, Wire, and Fasteners
products.description: Manufactured at dedicated facilities, these include steel mesh, wire products, and fasteners such as bolts, nuts, and washers for construction, automotive, and industrial markets.

products.name: Scrap Metal Recycling and Brokerage
products.description: Through The David J. Joseph Company, Nucor operates scrap recycling facilities and brokers ferrous and non-ferrous metals, pig iron, and DRI, selling to external steel mills, foundries, and other processors.

products.name: Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) Sales
products.description: Nucor produces DRI at two plants, supplying high-quality iron units as a scrap substitute to external steelmakers, though most is consumed internally.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Nucor owns and operates natural gas wells, selling produced gas to third parties to offset its own consumption costs in steel and DRI production.

products.name: Industrial Gas Sales
products.description: Through Universal Industrial Gases, Nucor operates air separation units, selling excess industrial gases on a merchant basis where market conditions allow.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of innovative medicines, including biologics, small molecules, and cell therapies, developed and manufactured to treat various cancers such as melanoma, lung, renal, gastric, esophageal, and hematologic malignancies. Delivered via oral, injectable, or infusion routes and distributed globally through regulated pharmaceutical channels.

products.name: Hematology Therapeutics
products.description: Medicines, including small molecules, biologics, and cell therapies, for the treatment of blood disorders such as multiple myeloma, lymphoma, leukemia, myelodysplastic syndromes, and anemia. Products are manufactured using complex chemical and biological processes and distributed through specialty pharmacies and hospitals.

products.name: Immunology Therapeutics
products.description: A range of biologic and small molecule drugs developed and manufactured to treat autoimmune and inflammatory diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, ulcerative colitis, and plaque psoriasis. Delivered orally or via injection/infusion and distributed through regulated pharmaceutical channels.

products.name: Cardiovascular Therapeutics
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs developed and manufactured to treat cardiovascular conditions such as atrial fibrillation, venous thromboembolism, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Products are distributed globally through wholesalers, specialty pharmacies, and hospitals.

products.name: Neuroscience Therapeutics
products.description: Oral small molecule and combination drugs developed and manufactured to treat neurological and psychiatric disorders such as multiple sclerosis, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and Alzheimer's disease. Products are distributed through specialty and retail pharmacies.

products.name: Electricity Generation and Supply
products.description: Production and sale of electricity generated from a diversified fleet including nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind, solar, and oil facilities. Electricity is delivered to wholesale and retail customers through physical infrastructure and market transactions, requiring large-scale physical assets, regulatory compliance, and operational expertise.

products.name: Retail Energy Supply (Electricity and Natural Gas)
products.description: Provision of electricity and natural gas to commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers nationwide, including product structuring, pricing, and customer service. Delivered through market-based contracts, leveraging both owned generation and market purchases, and supported by digital platforms and customer support teams.

products.name: Wholesale Power and Gas Marketing
products.description: Sale and trading of electricity and natural gas to utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and other wholesale entities, including participation in competitive utility load procurement, bilateral sales, and commodity risk management. Involves financial and physical transactions across all major U.S. power and gas markets.

products.name: Contracted Generation and Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs)
products.description: Sourcing and sale of electricity through long-term contracts with third-party generators, including unit-specific agreements and PPAs for renewable and non-renewable power. Enables provision of reliable supply and sustainability solutions to customers without direct ownership of generation assets.

products.name: Sustainability and Clean Energy Solutions
products.description: Provision of products and services to help customers achieve sustainability goals, including renewable energy certificates (RECs), carbon offsets, demand response, and carbon-free energy matching (e.g., CORe+, Hourly CFE). Delivered through digital platforms, advisory services, and customized contract structures.

products.name: Energy Efficiency and Behind-the-Meter Solutions
products.description: Implementation of energy efficiency upgrades and behind-the-meter solutions for customers, including facility optimization, performance contracting, and no-upfront-capital structures. Delivered through project management, technology deployment, and ongoing support to optimize energy consumption and reduce emissions.

products.name: Energy Data, Analytics, and Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of data-driven platforms and advisory services to help customers manage energy usage, carbon accounting, utility bill management, and sustainability strategy. Delivered via digital tools (e.g., Constellation Navigator) and expert advisors, enabling customers to track, analyze, and optimize their energy and environmental performance.

products.name: Battery Storage Solutions
products.description: Provision of grid-scale and customer-sited battery storage solutions, including ownership and operation of large battery storage assets and integration with renewable and conventional generation. Delivered through physical infrastructure and market participation to enhance grid reliability and support customer needs.

products.name: Blank Check Company Services
products.description: Wealthbridge Acquisition Limited offers services as a blank check company, raising capital through an IPO and private placements for the purpose of acquiring or merging with one or more target businesses. The company does not engage in substantive commercial business until a business combination is completed; its primary product is the facilitation of a business combination transaction, providing a public listing vehicle and access to capital for private companies seeking to go public.

products.name: Descartes-08 mRNA CAR-T Cell Therapy
products.description: An autologous cell therapy product candidate manufactured by collecting a patient's cells, expanding them, and introducing mRNA to deliver a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting BCMA. The product is administered as six weekly outpatient infusions without preconditioning chemotherapy, designed for the treatment of autoimmune diseases such as myasthenia gravis, myositis (including dermatomyositis and antisynthetase syndrome), and juvenile dermatomyositis.

products.name: Descartes-15 mRNA CAR-T Cell Therapy
products.description: A next-generation autologous anti-BCMA mRNA CAR-T cell therapy, designed to be more resistant to CAR recycling upon multiple antigen exposures and observed to be more potent in preclinical studies. Manufactured using proprietary technology and administered in outpatient settings, it has been tested in early clinical trials for multiple myeloma.

products.name: Nanoencapsulated Sirolimus plus Pegadricase (NASP, formerly SEL-212)
products.description: A drug candidate consisting of nanoencapsulated sirolimus plus pegadricase, developed for the treatment of chronic refractory gout. The product is licensed to Sobi for development and commercialization, with manufacturing and commercialization rights outside Greater China.

products.name: Crop Protection Products
products.description: Manufactured chemical products designed to protect crops from pests, diseases, and weeds, subject to regulatory approval and environmental safety evaluations.

products.name: Pawn Lending
products.description: Provision of small, short-term, non-recourse loans to customers, collateralized by personal property such as jewelry, electronics, tools, appliances, sporting goods, and musical instruments. Loans are originated and serviced in physical pawn store locations across the U.S., Latin America, and the U.K., with pledged items held as security until repayment or forfeiture.

products.name: Pawn Merchandise Sales
products.description: Retail sale of pre-owned consumer products, primarily sourced from forfeited pawn collateral and direct purchases from the public, including jewelry, electronics, tools, appliances, sporting goods, and musical instruments. Sales occur in physical pawn store locations, with some inventory acquired from wholesalers or manufacturers.

products.name: Retail POS Payment Solutions
products.description: Technology-enabled point-of-sale payment solutions offered through American First Finance (AFF), including lease-to-own (LTO), retail installment sales agreements (RISA), and bank-originated installment loans. These products are delivered via a digital platform to merchant partners (both brick-and-mortar and e-commerce) across the U.S., enabling customers to finance purchases of consumer goods and services.

products.name: Precious Metals and Diamonds Recycling
products.description: Acquisition and processing of unwanted or broken jewelry, which is melted or processed and resold as gold, silver, or diamonds in commodity markets. This involves physical handling and refining of precious metals sourced from pawn collateral and direct purchases.

products.name: Records Management Services
products.description: Physical storage and management of business records, vital records, and sensitive documents, including courier operations and secure handling. Delivered through a global network of storage facilities and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Information Management Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive digital solutions for information lifecycle management, including document conversion, digital storage, content management, workflow automation, and AI-powered analytics. Delivered via proprietary digital platforms and cloud infrastructure.

products.name: Data Center Services
products.description: Enterprise-class data center facilities offering secure, reliable, and flexible colocation and hyperscale-ready capacity for IT infrastructure, with a focus on compliance, security, and sustainability. Delivered through a global portfolio of owned and operated data centers.

products.name: Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM) Services
products.description: End-to-end IT asset lifecycle management, including decommissioning, data erasure, processing, disposition, recycling, resale, and workplace IT asset management. Services are enabled by secure logistics, chain of custody, and environmentally responsible processing.

products.name: Secure Shredding Services
products.description: Scheduled secure destruction of office records and sensitive documents, using both fixed shredding facilities and mobile shredding units. Includes provision of secure containers and chain of custody processes.

products.name: Media and Archive Services
products.description: Storage, safeguarding, and delivery of physical media assets for entertainment and media clients, as well as digital content repository systems for distribution and archiving. Delivered through specialized facilities and digital platforms.

products.name: Consumer Storage Services
products.description: On-demand, valet storage solutions for individual consumers, leveraging data analytics and machine learning for customer acquisition and a seamless storage experience. Delivered through a network of storage facilities and logistics.

products.name: Fine Arts Services
products.description: Specialized handling, installation, and storage of fine art, delivered by technical experts using secure and climate-controlled facilities.

products.name: Seniors Housing Property Investments
products.description: Ownership and investment in seniors housing properties, including independent living, assisted living, and memory care communities, delivered through fee ownership, sale-leasebacks, and joint ventures. These are physical real estate assets leased to third-party operators or managed by independent operators.

products.name: Skilled Nursing Facility Property Investments
products.description: Ownership and investment in skilled nursing facility (SNF) properties, which provide restorative, rehabilitative, and nursing care, delivered through fee ownership, triple-net leases, and mortgage financing. These are physical real estate assets leased to third-party operators or managed by independent operators.

products.name: Mortgage Financing for Seniors Housing and Health Care Properties
products.description: Provision of mortgage loans and construction loans secured by seniors housing and skilled nursing properties, including permanent and bridge financing. These are financial products requiring capital and underwriting expertise, not physical property management.

products.name: Structured Finance Solutions for Health Care Real Estate
products.description: Provision of structured finance solutions such as mezzanine loans, preferred equity, and bridge lending for seniors housing and health care properties. These are financial products requiring capital and structuring expertise, not direct property management.

products.name: Management of Seniors Housing Operating Portfolio (SHOP)
products.description: Management and oversight of seniors housing communities through third-party operators under the RIDEA structure, where LTC retains ownership and operational oversight while independent operators manage day-to-day operations. This involves contractual management agreements and oversight of property operations.

products.name: Embedded Software Platforms for Edge Systems (QNX)
products.description: Foundational, safety-certified, and secure embedded software platforms including operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, and development tools for automotive, industrial, medical, robotics, and other mission-critical applications. Delivered as licensed software and associated services, requiring deep software engineering and compliance with industry safety standards.

products.name: Asset Monitoring and Telematics Solutions (BlackBerry Radar)
products.description: Hardware devices and secure cloud-based dashboards for real-time tracking, monitoring, and analytics of transportation and logistics assets such as containers, trailers, and heavy machinery. Delivered as a combination of physical devices and cloud software, requiring manufacturing and secure data infrastructure.

products.name: Device Security and Authentication Solutions (BlackBerry Certicom)
products.description: Cryptography-based security solutions for device authentication, anti-counterfeiting, and product security, leveraging patented elliptic curve cryptography and managed public key infrastructure. Delivered as software and managed services, requiring cryptographic expertise and compliance with security standards.

products.name: Secure Voice, Messaging, and Conferencing Solutions (BlackBerry SecuSUITE)
products.description: Certified, multi-OS secure communications solutions for voice, messaging, and file sharing with advanced encryption and anti-eavesdropping, designed for governments, militaries, and enterprises. Delivered as software for mobile and desktop devices, requiring compliance with government security certifications.

products.name: Unified Endpoint Management (BlackBerry UEM and related)
products.description: Centralized software platforms for managing and securing diverse fleets of devices, applications, and content across operating systems, including secure containerization, regulatory compliance, and productivity tools. Delivered as enterprise software and cloud services, requiring integration with enterprise IT and regulatory frameworks.

products.name: Secure Enterprise File Sync and Share (BlackBerry Workspaces)
products.description: Enterprise-grade secure file sharing and synchronization solutions, enabling protected collaboration and digital rights management for sensitive documents. Delivered as software and cloud services, requiring secure infrastructure and compliance with enterprise security standards.

products.name: Critical Events Management and Crisis Communications (BlackBerry AtHoc)
products.description: Secure, networked crisis communications platforms for real-time mass notifications, incident management, and emergency operations, supporting both on-premise and cloud deployments. Delivered as software and cloud services, requiring integration with organizational infrastructure and compliance with public safety standards.

products.name: Professional and Engineering Consulting Services
products.description: Specialized consulting services to assist customers with product development, deployment, compliance, and mobility strategies, including engineering support for embedded systems and enterprise software. Delivered as in-person and remote expert services, requiring deep technical and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Technology and Patent Licensing
products.description: Licensing and monetization of the company’s global patent portfolio, including technologies in operating systems, networking, cybersecurity, cryptography, and wireless communications. Delivered as legal agreements and royalty arrangements, requiring intellectual property management and enforcement.

products.name: Public Venture Financing Services
products.description: Provision of early-stage and growth capital to startups and emerging technology companies, including structuring, underwriting, and facilitating private and public offerings (IPOs) through a self-clearing broker-dealer platform. Delivered via regulated financial infrastructure and in-person financial expertise.

products.name: Intellectual Property Strategy and Legal Services
products.description: Integrated intellectual property (IP) consulting, strategy development, and legal services for technology companies, including patent prosecution and IP portfolio management, delivered by a specialized law firm and proprietary software platform.

products.name: Longevity and Anti-Senescence Therapeutics
products.description: Development and commercialization of small molecule pharmaceutical drugs and related products targeting senescent cells to promote longevity and treat age-related diseases, based on licensed technology and subject to clinical development and regulatory approval.
